Solution Architect \- HR**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


Responsibilities: Contribute to the design and implementation of HR technology solutions that support business goals and improve employee experience. Work with HR and IT stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into scalable solution designs. Support the development of architecture frameworks for HR systems such as talent management, learning, and workforce planning. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure integration of HR platforms with enterprise systems, maintaining data consistency and compliance. Assist in evaluating and selecting HR tools and technologies based on business needs and technical feasibility. Provide technical input during solution development, testing, and deployment phases, ensuring alignment with architectural standards. Monitor solution performance and recommend improvements to enhance usability, efficiency, and data quality. Ensure HR solutions adhere to data governance, privacy, and security standards. Stay informed on HR technology trends and contribute insights to improve solution design and delivery.**Qualifications**
